premises.text: Existing apps find single venues or events but none compose places and events that go together for an occasion
premises.evidence_span: there's not a single product on the market today that can tell you what places and what events go together for your occasion

premises.text: Planning starts from mood, companions, optional focal events, and fresh local review snippets, including Facebook-personalized itineraries
premises.evidence_span: most people, when planning any social occasion, think of two things. What's my mood and who's coming with me?

premises.text: Algorithms classify, rank, and compose live web places/events into itineraries without hand curation
premises.evidence_span: Everything's algorithmically generated. Not a single thing is hand curated

premises.text: Plans include review snippets, directions, and booking links (OpenTable, StubHub, etc.) and can be customized
premises.evidence_span: You even have relevant information about each place, and you can get directions from place to place to place here, as well as booking links out to OpenTable

premises.text: Friends can collaboratively edit plans via Facebook notifications in real time
premises.evidence_span: They all get a Facebook notification saying I've asked them for some advice on my WeOtta plan

premises.text: Finished plans can be turned into Facebook events with places and booking links in seconds
premises.evidence_span: making a Facebook event on WIATA is that it's even easier than making a Facebook event on Facebook site itself

value.text: Personal-concierge style answers for what to do tonight with hassle-free composed plans
value.evidence_span: solves the problem of what to do tonight. It also takes all the hassle out of planning it

causal_links.evidence_span: WIATA is a lot like having your own personal concierge
composing them into itineraries to fit my needs
we're going to do this plan together tonight

notes: Mood/companions/event/review interview findings folded as one planning-input package for the occasion problem (§4.1.6–7). Algorithmic compose+rank kept as core product mechanism; booking/review/directions as cascade of plan utility. Friend collab and Facebook-event export split as social GTM/collaboration module. Stage banter not coded.
